verdict.rationale:
Parahelp's Internal Agent is explicitly a built-in AI assistant you delegate work to in natural language — configuring support flows, running simulations/tests, generating gap reports, and publishing releases — all documented as first-party features (parahelp-docs-1, -24, -25, -27, -19). This directly matches the 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant' story.
Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on the breadth of task types the assistant can autonomously execute.
